table_title: Table 9.11.2.15.1: Service-level-AA payload type information element
rows: If the service-level-AA payload type indicates UUAA payload, the field for the service-level-AA payload of the Service-level AA payload information element is an application layer payload for UUAA procedure between the UE supporting UAS services and the USS.

If the service-level-AA payload type indicates C2 authorization payload, the field for the service-level-AA payload of the Service-level-AA payload information element is an application layer payload for C2 authorization procedure between the UE supporting UAS services and the USS.
